Foreigner Praises Inexpensive Indian Sleeper Bus Travel

A British man documented his journey on a sleeper bus from Delhi to Jaipur, a trip costing approximately ₹400. He expressed surprise and admiration for the affordability and quality of the service, suggesting Europe could learn from India's travel options. The man shared his experience through a video, which garnered attention.
